Redefining everyday hydration

Hydraa is a premium alkaline drinking water brand created for people who prioritise better hydration and a balanced lifestyle.

By combining purity, a clean mineral boost and a modern experience, we deliver high-quality, pH 8.5+ ionised water at an accessible price.

Every bottle goes through multi-stage filtration, advanced ionisation and a balanced mineral boost before it is tested and sealed in a sterile environment. The result is water that tastes smooth and clean — the kind you actually want to drink more of, at home, at the gym, at work or on the move.
